description.value: Dageraad Brewing is an award-winning small-batch artisan brewery specializing in Belgian-inspired beers, recognized as 2018 Brewery of the Year by the Canadian Brewing Awards. The tasting room offers a 50-seat indoor space plus a 50-seat covered, heated patio in a Burnaby warehouse, just a five-minute walk from Production Way SkyTrain station. An extensive rotating lineup of Belgian-style ales — from saisons and dubbels to mixed-culture fermented table beers — is available on-site and via an online webstore for delivery across BC.
